details:
Add a drag-based arm control (like grab master the game) 

system for VRChat Mobile that lets players move and extend an avatar’s arm using on-screen touch controls.

This mechanic would give mobile users a fun, intuitive way to reach, point, grab, or interact with world objects and avatars.

 How It Works

A floating touch circle appears on the screen of the mobile device 

Players drag their thumb inside the circle to control the arm’s direction and reach.

Drag distance controls how far the arm extends.

Drag direction determines where it moves or points. 

Double-tap or long press could trigger a grasp or interact action.

Releasing the drag returns the arm to a resting position.

WHAT IT WILL LOOK LIKE FOR OTHERS 

The arm moves smoothly with touch input, with optional visual effects like glow or fade.

Players can adjust control sensitivity, UI size, and screen position (left or right).

Designed to run efficiently on mobile devices, using lightweight animations and effects.

Why This Would Be Great for VRChat Mobile

Adds a new level of avatar interaction and expressiveness on mobile.

Makes mobile gameplay more engaging, going beyond simple emotes.

Gives mobile users an intuitive and accessible way to interact with worlds and objects.

Encourages creative avatar designs that use arm gestures or remote interactions
title: Ways to move hands on mobile  (I have the idea as well)
